SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-03-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-03-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF JUN YAU YANG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT RIVALDO REID IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-03-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF YANG, JUN YAU RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT REID, RIVALDO $2,600.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,650.00, COURT FINDS TENANT OWES RENT OF $3,300. TENANT DEPOSITED $1000.00 AS A SECURITY DEPOSIT. FROM THIS DEPOSIT, $300 IS DEDUCTED FOR SCRATCHED FLOORS LEAVING A BALANCE OF $700 LEFT IN THE SECURITY DEPOSIT AND DEDUCTED FROM RENT OWED LEAVING A BALANCE OWING OF $2600. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAY-01-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
